Hayworth Market
Summer Sale: July 1-30

Look in the Falls Creek newspaper for a

Tomato plant: $10.50 each

Visit us Tuesday-Sunday, 9 A.M-6 PM.
102 Sellar Road, Falls Creek, PA 15840

We grow everything right here on our farm.

@ 1Sal
